_comment: Lookup Router: where each feature lives. Globs (folder patterns) match tracked files, so new files inside a domain's folders are picked up automatically. Brackets and parentheses are literal ([id].tsx, (auth)). A domain starts 'planned' and becomes 'active' at its first finished task; map --check fails only for active domains whose globs match nothing. unmapped_ok lists shared code that belongs to no single feature.

engine.purpose: The game rules engine: state, actions, saves, emails, Pattern Book, Build checks

content.purpose: Typed data files copied from the docs: incidents, repeats, Builds, extra steps, Shop, cast, stages

desktop.purpose: The page, the BlipOS desktop, taskbar, icons, alerts, tutorial spotlight and game state hook

windows.purpose: Every window: Incident, Inbox, Shop, Stats, Pattern Book, System Map, Blueprint, Terminal, SysDash and the rest

room.purpose: The room around the computer: clips, stills, zoom and desk items

project.purpose: Game docs, the docs check, tooling, CI, config and workspace tasks
